meta.title: Chinese to English Voice Translator | IQ Translate
meta.description: Translate Chinese to English by voice or text: speak or paste characters, read and hear the English at once, reply back in Chinese. Free, no sign-up.
meta.ogDescription: Speak or paste Chinese and get the English meaning in seconds, spoken or written. Reply in English and it goes back in Chinese.

hero.title: Chinese to English translator
hero.description: Chinese writes without spaces and speaks in tones, so neither half is easy to look up by hand. Record it or paste it and read the English, then answer in English and send it back in Chinese.
hero.mockToPhrase: Excuse me, where is the bathroom?

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Chinese into English.

items.q: Do I need a Chinese input method?
items.a: No. Speak into the mic or paste the characters you were sent — you never type Chinese yourself.

items.q: Does it handle simplified and traditional characters?
items.a: Yes, paste either and the English comes back the same way.
